item.title: Change Coupling: How Git History Reveals Conway's Law Violations
item.description: We ran change coupling analysis on MongoDB's open-source repository. 208 module pairs cross team boundaries in the commit history — and the direction of that coupling tells you something no architecture diagram can.

item.title: How to Measure Bus Factor in Your Software Team
item.description: Bus factor tells you how many people you can lose before a project stalls. Most teams guess. Here's how to measure it directly from Git history — no surveys, no interviews.

item.title: The Review Is Too Late
item.description: Everyone is optimising the code review. But the review isn't where quality gets decided — it's where quality gets caught. In the age of AI-generated code, that distinction matters more than ever.
